framework.name: Frontend Best Practices Evaluation
framework.description: Evaluates the Vite/React frontend for performance, accessibility, SEO, UX patterns, and modern React best practices. The FGC Upper Room website serves a church congregation — it must be fast on mobile (many Nigerian users on slower connections), accessible, and easy to navigate.

context.tech_stack: Vite 5+, React 18+, React Router, CSS Variables, Google Fonts (Manrope & Spectral)
context.target_audience: Church congregation in Mgbuoba, Nigeria. Primarily mobile users. Variable network speeds.

rubric.1-2: Critical: Major usability or performance issues. Site is unusable for target audience.
rubric.3-4: Poor: Significant problems affecting user experience.
rubric.5-6: Fair: Functional but with notable gaps.
rubric.7-8: Good: Solid implementation with minor improvements possible.

categories.name: Performance & Loading
categories.description: Critical for Nigerian mobile users on 3G/4G connections.

criteria.name: Bundle Size & Code Splitting
what_to_check: Run 'npm run build' and check dist/ sizes
Total JS bundle under 200KB gzipped for initial load
Route-based code splitting with React.lazy() and Suspense
Admin pages including the new giving dashboard are lazy-loaded (not in main bundle)
No large libraries imported that are only used on one page
Tree-shaking is effective (no barrel file re-exports pulling in unused code)
criteria.remediation: Add React.lazy() for Admin, Media, Blog pages. Analyze bundle with 'npx vite-bundle-visualizer'. Split vendor chunks in vite.config.

criteria.name: Image Optimization
what_to_check: Images use modern formats (WebP, AVIF) with fallbacks
Images are appropriately sized (not 4000px wide for a 400px display)
Lazy loading on below-fold images (loading='lazy')
Hero/above-fold images are preloaded
Image dimensions specified to prevent layout shift (width/height or aspect-ratio)
criteria.remediation: Convert images to WebP. Use responsive images (srcset). Add loading='lazy' to below-fold images. Specify dimensions.

criteria.name: Font Loading
what_to_check: Google Fonts (Manrope & Spectral) loaded with display=swap
Font files are preloaded or self-hosted for faster loading
Fallback fonts specified in font stack
No FOUT (flash of unstyled text) or FOIT (flash of invisible text)
criteria.remediation: Add font-display: swap. Consider self-hosting fonts for faster loads on slow connections. Preload critical fonts in <head>.

criteria.name: Core Web Vitals Readiness
what_to_check: LCP (Largest Contentful Paint) target: under 2.5s on 4G
CLS (Cumulative Layout Shift) target: under 0.1
INP (Interaction to Next Paint) target: under 200ms
No render-blocking resources in <head>
CSS is minimal and critical CSS is inlined or loaded first
criteria.remediation: Profile with Lighthouse. Optimize LCP element (usually hero image or text). Prevent CLS with explicit dimensions. Minimize JS execution for INP.

criteria.name: PWA Readiness
what_to_check: manifest.json (or manifest.webmanifest) exists with proper icons, name, theme_color, start_url
Service worker is registered for offline capability
Offline fallback page exists (at minimum, cached service times and contact info)
App is installable on mobile (meets PWA installability criteria)
Cache strategy defined: which assets are cached, for how long
known_issues: IMPLEMENTATION_TODOS.md lists PWA as a strategic feature — check current implementation status
Particularly important for Nigerian mobile users with spotty 3G/4G connectivity
criteria.remediation: Add manifest.json with church branding. Register a service worker (vite-plugin-pwa or Workbox). Cache static assets and key content pages. Add offline fallback showing service times and contact info.

criteria.name: Semantic HTML
what_to_check: Proper use of heading hierarchy (h1 -> h2 -> h3, no skipping levels)
Only one h1 per page
Navigation uses <nav> element
Main content in <main> element
Footer in <footer>, header in <header>
Lists use <ul>/<ol>, not divs with bullet characters
Buttons are <button>, links are <a> (not divs with onClick)
criteria.remediation: Audit HTML structure. Replace divs-as-buttons with proper elements. Fix heading hierarchy.

criteria.name: ARIA & Screen Reader Support
what_to_check: Images have meaningful alt text (not 'image1.jpg')
Decorative images have alt='' or role='presentation'
Form inputs have associated labels (<label htmlFor>)
Error messages are announced to screen readers (aria-live or role='alert')
Modal dialogs trap focus and have aria-modal
Skip-to-content link exists
criteria.remediation: Add alt text to all images. Associate all form labels. Add skip-to-content link. Test with screen reader.

criteria.name: Keyboard Navigation
what_to_check: All interactive elements are keyboard accessible (Tab, Enter, Escape)
Focus states are visible (not removed by outline:none without replacement)
Tab order is logical (follows visual layout)
Dropdown menus are keyboard navigable
Mobile menu can be opened/closed with keyboard
criteria.remediation: Test full site with keyboard only. Ensure focus styles are visible. Fix any keyboard traps.

criteria.name: Color & Contrast
what_to_check: Text meets WCAG AA contrast ratio (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
Foursquare branding colors meet contrast requirements against backgrounds
Information is not conveyed by color alone
Links are distinguishable from surrounding text (not just color)
criteria.remediation: Test with contrast checker tool. Adjust colors where needed while respecting Foursquare branding.

criteria.name: Meta Tags & Structure
what_to_check: Each page has unique <title> and <meta description>
Open Graph tags for social sharing (og:title, og:description, og:image)
Canonical URLs are set
React Helmet or equivalent for dynamic meta tags
robots.txt exists and is appropriate
sitemap.xml exists (generated from routes)
criteria.remediation: Add React Helmet (or Vite plugin) for per-page meta. Create sitemap.xml. Add OG tags for social sharing.

criteria.name: SPA SEO Considerations
what_to_check: Client-side routing doesn't break direct URL access (React Router + server config)
404 page exists for unknown routes
Dynamic content (events, blog posts) has proper URL structure
Pre-rendering or SSR considered for public pages (if SEO is important)
criteria.remediation: Ensure nginx/server returns index.html for all routes (SPA fallback). Add 404 route. Consider prerendering for key pages.

categories.name: Responsive Design & Mobile
categories.description: Most church members will access on mobile phones.

criteria.name: Mobile-First Implementation
what_to_check: Base styles are mobile, media queries scale up (not desktop-first with mobile overrides)
Touch targets are at least 44x44px (Apple guideline) or 48x48px (Material guideline)
No horizontal scroll on any mobile viewport
Text is readable without zooming (16px minimum body text)
Forms are usable on mobile (appropriate input types, large enough fields)
criteria.remediation: Test on 320px, 375px, 414px viewports. Fix any horizontal overflow. Increase touch targets.

criteria.name: Offline & Low Connectivity
what_to_check: Service worker for offline support (consider for a church app)
Meaningful loading states while data fetches
Error states for network failures (not just blank screens)
Images degrade gracefully on slow connections
Critical content (service times, location, contact) is in static HTML, not API-dependent
criteria.remediation: Add loading and error states to all data-dependent components. Consider a service worker for offline access to key info. Ensure service times are in static markup.

criteria.name: Internationalization (i18n) Readiness
what_to_check: src/i18n/ directory exists with literalTranslations.js and messages.js — evaluate completeness
Are translations actually used throughout components, or is it dead/half-done code?
Check if hardcoded English strings exist alongside the i18n system (inconsistent usage)
Date, time, and number formatting uses locale-aware functions
RTL layout support if any target languages require it
known_issues: src/i18n/ directory exists with literalTranslations.js and messages.js — assess whether internationalization is complete, half-done, or dead code that should be cleaned up
criteria.remediation: If i18n is a priority, complete the translation coverage across all components. If not, either finish it or remove the dead code to reduce confusion. Document the decision.

criteria.name: Navigation & Information Architecture
what_to_check: Primary navigation is clear and consistent across all pages
Current page is indicated in navigation
Mobile menu is easy to open/close
Important actions (contact, give, attend) are prominently accessible
Breadcrumbs or back navigation on nested pages
criteria.remediation: Highlight active nav item. Ensure key CTAs are visible. Test navigation flow on mobile.

criteria.name: Form UX
what_to_check: Contact form provides inline validation (not just on submit)
Success/error states are clear and prominent
Form fields have appropriate input types (email, tel, etc.)
Submission button shows loading state during API call
Form doesn't lose data on accidental navigation
criteria.remediation: Add inline validation. Show loading state on submit. Use appropriate HTML5 input types.

evaluation_instructions.for_claude_code: Evaluate by: 1) Run 'npm run build' and analyze output sizes, 2) Review all component files for accessibility and semantic HTML, 3) Check CSS for responsive patterns, 4) Review index.html for meta tags and font loading, 5) Check all images for alt text and optimization, 6) Review React Router config for code splitting. Score each criterion with evidence.
